name: VisitSummary
description: A concise summary of a patient's visit, often derived from their medical record.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning patient — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning patient or an admin/doctor may access this summary.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: The patient this visit summary belongs to.

attributes.name: doctorId
attributes.description: The doctor who created this summary.

attributes.name: appointmentId
attributes.description: The appointment this summary is for.

attributes.name: summaryDate
attributes.description: The date the visit summary was created.

attributes.name: summaryContent
attributes.description: The concise summary of the patient's visit.

attributes.name: recommendations
attributes.description: Recommendations or next steps from the doctor.
